description.value: Bells and Whistles is a casual beer hall and burger joint on Fraser Street serving made-to-order Americana classics — cheeseburgers, fried chicken, onion rings, and soft serve ice cream — using fresh, locally-sourced ingredients. The restaurant has earned coverage in BonAppetit and the Georgia Straight, and won a Golden Owl Award for Best New Destination in 2018. Weekend brunch, off-sales, and a private dining room make it a versatile stop.
